title: Co-projection composition is the mate of projection associativity
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum of [sk-def-purity-conv], with $A=A_{E,n}$, and the bounded constructible finite-Tor pro-etale categories and operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the constructible exceptional inverse images of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], which carry $D^b_{ctf}$ into $D^b_{ctf}$. For a separated finite-type morphism $h:S\to T$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $K\in D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ and a tensor-invertible $N\in D^b_{ctf}(T,A)$ [pur9-cs-def-invertible] with a chosen inverse $N'$ and evaluation $N\otimes^LN'\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T$, let $$\kappa_{h,K,N}:Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N\longrightarrow Rh^!(K\otimes^LN)$$ be the morphism corresponding, under the adjunction bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_T(Rh_!P,Q)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_S(P,Rh^!Q)$ of $Rh_!\dashv Rh^!$ used in [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition], to the composite $$Rh_!(Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N)\cong\bigl(Rh_!(Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N)\otimes^LN'\bigr)\otimes^LN\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}_{h,Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N,N'}\otimes1}Rh_!(Rh^!K\otimes^LLh^*N\otimes^LLh^*N')\otimes^LN\cong Rh_!Rh^!K\otimes^LN\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{h,K}\otimes1}K\otimes^LN,$$ where $\operatorname{PF}$ is the specified projection transformation of [def-exchange-projection], $\varepsilon_h$ is the counit, and the unlabelled isomorphisms are the evaluation, the tensor associators and unit constraints, and $Lh^*N\otimes^LLh^*N'\cong Lh^*(N\otimes^LN')\cong A_S$ through the tensor-pullback comparison $\mu_h$ of [def-exchange-projection]. (It does not depend on the choice of $(N',\text{evaluation})$; it is the conjugate of $\operatorname{PF}_{h,(-),N'}$ under $Rh_!\dashv Rh^!$ and $(-)\otimes^LN'\dashv(-)\otimes^LN$, and when $h$ is a closed immersion its inverse is the co-projection isomorphism of [lem-pur-coprojection].) Now let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $c_{g,f}:R(gf)^!\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf^!Rg^!$ be the exceptional composition comparison of [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition] (invertible, being the mate of the compact-support compositor $\alpha_{g,f}$ of [thm-sf-comp-composition] by [lem-sf-mate]), and let $\mathrm{can}:L(gf)^*N\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf^*Lg^*N$ be the pullback-composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Then for $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,A)$ and tensor-invertible $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Z,A)$: $$c_{g,f,K\otimes^LN}\circ\kappa_{gf,K,N}=Rf^!(\kappa_{g,K,N})\circ\kappa_{f,Rg^!K,Lg^*N}\circ(c_{g,f,K}\otimes\mathrm{can}):R(gf)^!K\otimes^LL(gf)^*N\longrightarrow Rf^!Rg^!(K\otimes^LN).$$ Equivalently, whenever $\kappa_g,\kappa_f,\kappa_{gf}$ are invertible and $\operatorname{coProj}_h:=\kappa_h^{-1}$, $(c_{g,f,K}\otimes\mathrm{can})\circ\operatorname{coProj}_{gf,K,N}=\operatorname{coProj}_{f,Rg^!K,Lg^*N}\circ Rf^!(\operatorname{coProj}_{g,K,N})\circ c_{g,f,K\otimes^LN}$.
